description: Pulls the requested fields (or named entities when no fields are given) out of free text and returns valid JSON: names, dates, amounts, addresses, tickers. 0.01 USDC per call via x402.

fields.description: Comma separated field names to extract; empty = people, organizations, places, dates, amounts, tickers

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: ai_extract
